text: Saltmarrow harbour, {player}. Mind the mooring lines, they bite.
Back again? The harbour fees haven't gone down, if that's what you're hoping.
Ysolde Vane, harbormistress. Whatever you need, make it quick: I've three ships wanting the same berth.
So you're the castaway Wren sent word about. You look less drowned than I expected.
You've got a bounty on you and you walk straight into my harbour office. Bold. I didn't see you. Make it quick.
The captain who brought down Ashmere Thorne. Berths are free for you, forever. Don't tell the others.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: How did you end up running the harbour?
How do ships work around here?

text: Saltmarrow's the freest port in the Reach. The Brethren keep the peace, more or less, and the Tidewatch keeps its distance, more or less.
The tavern's up the hill: Mags Tallow sells Brethren contracts there, and there's a card table if you've money to lose. Quartermaster Brack and Trader Oona are in the square.

options.label: Where do I get a ship?

text: Brethren broker. Keeps the book of every job, every debt and every grudge in Saltmarrow. Pays well, forgets nothing.
My father ran this harbour, and his mother before him. Vanes have been telling captains where to tie up for a hundred years.
I had a ship once. The Kestrel. Sold her to pay for the new breakwater. Best trade I ever made, and the worst.
Every evening, when the sun goes down behind the mole. Then the morning comes, and somebody's anchored in the wrong berth, and I forget again.
Hollis Pike at the shipyard sells sloops and trades up: your old deed and some coin for a bigger hull. Schooners, brigs, frigates if you're rich.
Raise sail with R, drop it with V, fire broadsides with Z and X. Mind the wind: it's everything out there. And press H aboard to go below deck.
